newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Oct exports hit by technical glitches.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Oct exports hit by technical glitches.

text.p: Brazilian exports of $4.188 billion in October were negatively affected by a computer glitch but also benefited from a Customs bungle, a senior Ministry of Industry and Commerce official said.
Foreign trade secretary Mauricio Cortes told reporters six hours worth of export data were lost on October 31 and would be included in November's figures.
But he also acknowledged that a corresponding level of exports from September were carried over into October after a problem with Customs left some shipments unregistered.
"It would be highly speculative but they (the exports lost in October and those carried over from September) could well be something similar," Cortes said.
Cortes said that on October 31, only $70.2 million worth of exports were registered.
By October 30, the daily average export figure for the month had stood at $196.1 million after exports that day of $213 million.
Due to the computer glitch, the daily average for October slumped to $190.4 million.
Cortes said that exports for November so far stood at just over $467 million, with a daily average of $233.9 million.
On Friday November 1, exports were $241.5 million and on Monday November 4, $209.3 million. Weekend exports totalled some $16.64 million.
